# Purpose
This header file defines generated metric metadata for the `bankf_transaction_result` counter. It includes `fd_metrics_base.h` and `fd_metrics_enums.h`, then declares the counter name, type, description, converter, total count, and the bit offsets for each transaction result value such as `SUCCESS`, `INSTRUCTON_ERROR`, and `SIGNATURE_FAILURE`. The file also declares the external array `FD_METRICS_BANKF`, which holds the metric definitions used by the metrics system. The include guard prevents multiple inclusion, and the comment states that `gen_metrics.py` generates the file and that it must not be edited by hand.
